messages:
elena (product): @channel Heads-up — Hosted API streaming + function/tool-calls are GA starting today :tada:. We also added a new recommended model 'redwood-trunk-3.5b' for a good latency/cost balance. Docs + migration notes: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/hosted/streaming-tool-calls. Please read the rollout notes below and ping if you need early access to the canary.

mike (eng-runtime): Quick implementation details: no breaking changes to existing endpoints. New behavior is opt-in via `stream=true` or `Accept: text/event-stream`. Function/tool calls use the same /v1/generate route with `tools` in the payload. SDKs v0.9.7+ have native streaming & tool-call helpers. Example curl (streaming SSE):

```bash
curl -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-trunk-3.5b","stream":true}'
```

sam (eng-sre): Rollout plan: canary started 08:00 UTC for premium tenants, global enablement happening now. Default per-tenant throttle = 20 rps while we monitor. If you see errors or latency regression, switch to a pinned model variant or open a support ticket and we'll flip your traffic back.

elena (product): Customer-facing launches: marketing will publish a blog and console banners. We added migration docs and a checklist for devs (schema expectations for tool responses, retry semantics, token accounting). Note: streaming responses change billing with per-token streaming accounting — expect small billing delta for long lived connections.

liz (marketing): We'll publish the blog at 15:00 PT and send the customer email right after. Can product/eng ops share 1–2 screenshots and a short quote before noon? Also drafting the FAQ.

deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: hosted-runtime v3.12.0 -> rolling to all regions (regions: us-west1, us-east4, eu-west2, ap-southeast1). Canary tag: hosted-runtime-canary-2026-04-11-0815.

mike (eng-runtime): Notes for integrators: watch for these headers: `X-Redwood-Stream-Chunk: true` and `X-Tool-Invocation: <id>`. Tools must return valid JSON line-delimited payloads; we'll validate and emit an event if malformed. There is a short compatibility shim for older SDKs but we highly recommend upgrading.

sam (eng-sre): Observability: dashboards created under Console → Observability → Streaming. Alerts: streaming-error-rate > 1% for 5m triggers P0 paging to eng-oncall. Please subscribe if you own a customer integration.

jen (ceo): Huge thanks to product + runtime + SRE teams — impressive work. :clap: Looking forward to the customer feedback.
